suggested_requirements.text: The system shall provide a boot menu upon startup.
The system shall allow the user to select a keyboard keymap.
The system shall allow the user to select a language.
The system shall provide a graphical desktop environment.
The system shall allow the user to refresh the list of connected devices.
The system shall allow the user to undo pending operations.
The system shall allow the user to apply pending operations.
The system shall display information about a selected device.
The system shall allow the user to create a partition table on a device.
The system shall allow the user to create a new partition.
The system shall allow the user to delete a partition.
The system shall allow the user to resize or move a partition.
The system shall allow the user to copy a partition to the clipboard.
The system shall allow the user to paste a copied partition into unallocated space.
The system shall allow the user to format a partition with a supported file system.
The system shall allow the user to unmount a partition.
The system shall allow the user to manage partition flags.
The system shall allow the user to check and repair a file system.
The system shall allow the user to label a partition.
The system shall allow the user to take a screenshot of the desktop or an active window.
The system shall provide a terminal interface for command line operations.
The system shall allow the user to change the screen resolution.
The system shall grant the user administrator rights and root access by default.
The system shall provide a graphical user interface for partition management.
The system shall be distributed under the GNU General Public License version 2 or later.
